history.p: "Agnete og Havfruerne" was originally part of Hans Christian Andersen's dramatic poem "Agnete og Havmanden" (NWGW 151). It became very popular in this version for solo soprano and women's choir.

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in cardboard cover with marbled sides. In the middle of the front cover a handwritten label inscribed "N.W. Gade / Agnete og Havfruerne / [added in pencil:] Op. 3 / Partitur.". Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. Paginated 1-8. Heading on p. 1: "Agnete og Havfruerne / Texten af H.C. Andersen. / Musiken af Niels W. Gade." Added later in upper right-hand corner: "Agnete und die Meerfrauen. / Gedicht von H.C. Andersen / componirt / für eine Solostimme, / Frauenchor u. Orchester / von / Niels W. Gade. Clavierauszug." After the final doublebar: "Fine / [Gade's musical signature] 1851."
